title: Answering who-questions with ei kukaan
focus: To say nobody, use kukaan with a negative verb. Kuka tulee? — Kukaan ei tule.
prerequisiteSkills: Negative information questions with plural action verbs

exercises.prompt: Answer “Kuka tulee?”: choose “Nobody is coming.”
exercises.explanation: Singular refers to one person or one thing in these patterns. Ei kukaan is a natural short reply to Kuka tulee? (“Who is coming?”). A full reply gives kukaan + ei + the negative main-verb form. Do not translate nobody by putting ei before an affirmative verb form, and do not use plural eivät with kukaan here. The complete reply means “Nobody is coming”.
